general.description: Includes access to both SoMa and Potrero Hill: 80+ wheels, 60+ glazes across the two studios, and 4 slab rollers. Members get dedicated shelf space and first access to "Power Hour" classes, held 6–8 times a month. Woodshop access is available once certified. 24/7 access can be added for $25/month.

woodshop.description: Requires comfort working unassisted, the ability to mill lumber independently, and respect for a shared space. No ceramics access included.

workingArtist.description: Private work space and 24/7 access to the Potrero studio, plus one bisque firing and one glaze firing every month on a dedicated kiln. Three-month minimum commitment.
